title: Deployment & Hosting — Separate Build from Release
key_insight: Create an immutable artifact, test it, then promote that exact artifact between environments. A release selects the version receiving traffic.
body:
## Separate Build from Release

Building new code and sending all traffic to it in one step makes rollback difficult.

Create an immutable artifact, test it, then promote that exact artifact between environments. A release selects the version receiving traffic.

Run database and index changes with compatibility windows so old and new application versions can coexist during rollout.
common_mistakes: A laptop environment is automatically reproducible.
Adding web servers fixes every downstream bottleneck.
Health checks prove model answer quality.
mini_exercise: Draw “Separate Build from Release” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: Deployment turns a working AI service into a repeatable, secure, scalable runtime.
